name: Synthwave sunset
description: Low-poly terrain flown at speed under a banded sun. The height field is a triangulated value noise, so the ground is hard-faceted rather than smooth, and the same barycentric work yields the distance to each triangle edge — which is what the neon wireframe is drawn from, for free.

wire.description: Brightness of the neon edge on every triangle.

pulse.description: How hard the bass pushes the whole field down and back up.
